verdict.rationale: Spline is a cloud-hosted design tool with built-in AI features (AI Agent, AI textures, AI 3D generation), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, data-usage controls, or any policy on training with user files. With no evidence for an applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
